articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: India Prepares for Crewed Submersible MATSYA-6000 Sea Trials
articles.summary: Ministry of Earth Sciences advances deep-water qualification tests for MATSYA-6000 to explore polymetallic nodules in the Indian Ocean.
prelims: MATSYA-6000 is an indigenous crewed submersible designed to reach ocean depths of 6,000 meters.
The Deep Ocean Mission is a central sector scheme implemented by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
The International Seabed Authority (ISA) has designated exploration areas in the Central Indian Ocean Basin to India for poly-metallic nodules.
articles.mains: Examine the strategic and economic significance of India's Deep Ocean Mission for critical mineral security and blue economy expansion.

articles.title: National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan (NBSAP) Alignment with 30x30 Target
articles.summary: India updates its National Biodiversity Framework to align with the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework goals.
prelims: The 30x30 target seeks to designate 30% of Earth's land and ocean areas as protected zones by 2030.
NBSAP updates are mandated under the United Nations Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) commitments.
Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (OECMs) are integrated alongside traditional protected forests.
articles.mains: Discuss how integrating Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (OECMs) can balance economic development with biodiversity protection in India.

articles.title: Operationalisation of Chennai-Vladivostok Eastern Maritime Corridor (EMC)
articles.summary: India and Russia streamline maritime operations along the Eastern Maritime Corridor to reduce trans-Eurasian supply chain timelines.
prelims: EMC connects Chennai Port on India's eastern coast directly to Vladivostok in the Russian Far East.
The route reduces freight shipping duration between India and Far East Russia from 40 days to approximately 24 days.
The corridor acts as a complementary route to the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC).
articles.mains: Analyze the geopolitical and economic implications of the Eastern Maritime Corridor for India's Indo-Pacific strategy and energy security.

articles.title: Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) 2.0 Framework for Interoperable Governance
articles.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology releases operational guidelines for scaling AgriStack and National Health Stack.
prelims: Digital Public Infrastructure relies on foundational layers: Digital Identity (Aadhaar), Real-time Payments (UPI), and Open Data Access.
AgriStack introduces unified farmer identification (Farmer ID) integrated with land record registries.
The G20 New Delhi Leaders' Declaration previously endorsed India's conceptual blueprint for global DPI deployment.
articles.mains: Assess the role of open digital architecture in reducing transaction costs and improving administrative transparency in public service delivery.

articles.title: RBI Mandates Disclosure Framework on Climate-Related Financial Risks
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India mandates regulated financial entities to implement climate risk assessments and green asset stress tests.
prelims: The RBI framework classifies climate risks into physical risks (weather damage) and transition risks (policy shift impacts).
Guidelines align with international benchmarks set by the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD).
Regulated entities must disclose portfolio exposure to carbon-intensive sectors on an annual basis.
articles.mains: Evaluate the necessity of regulatory oversight in green financing to safeguard systemic financial stability against climate-induced vulnerabilities.
